info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector recognizeText API

params.name: detectHandwriting
params.description: If 'true' is specified, handwriting recognition is performed. If this parameter is set to 'false' or is not specified, printed text recognition is performed.

items.docs: Recognize Text operation. When you use the Recognize Text interface, the response contains a field called 'Operation-Location'. The 'Operation-Location' field contains the URL that you must use for your Get Handwritten Text Operation Result operation.
